mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%) triggers imminent Federal Reserve tightening, causing immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by >1.0% MoM signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1.0% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a concurrent payroll decline (PAYEMS < 0.5% MoM) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) contracting below 107.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 107.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing market strength (HOUST > 1200.0 thousand units) signals robust consumer confidence and rising disposable income, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%) fuels wage growth and corporate cost pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through reduced profit margins.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars) signal strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when RSAFS > 450000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
